description: Retrieval eval dataset for REOS RAG. Each case has a question, a set of candidate passages (one relevant, rest distractors), and the id of the passage that must rank first.

cases.question: What is the remaining lease term for the anchor tenant?

passages.text: The anchor tenant, Lakeside Grocers, has a remaining lease term of 7 years with two 5-year renewal options at fixed escalations of 2.5% annually.
Parking ratios at the property are 4.2 spaces per 1,000 square feet, exceeding the municipal minimum requirement.
The roof was replaced in 2021 with a TPO membrane carrying a 20-year manufacturer warranty.

cases.question: Were any environmental issues identified in the Phase I assessment?

passages.text: The property's net operating income for the trailing twelve months was $2.4 million on revenues of $3.6 million.

The Phase I environmental site assessment identified a recognized environmental condition related to a former dry cleaning operation on an adjacent parcel; a Phase II subsurface investigation is recommended.
Zoning for the parcel is C-2 commercial, permitting retail, office, and restaurant uses by right.

cases.question: When does the existing loan mature and what is the interest rate?

passages.text: Tenant improvement allowances for new leases average $35 per square foot across recent comparable transactions.
The property management agreement carries a fee of 3% of effective gross income and renews annually.
The existing senior loan matures in March 2028, bears interest at a fixed rate of 5.85%, and carries a yield maintenance prepayment penalty through maturity.

cases.question: What is the current occupancy rate of the building?

passages.text: As of the rent roll dated June 1, the building is 93.5% occupied across 41 of 44 suites, with weighted average lease expiry of 4.2 years.
Insurance premiums increased 18% year over year, driven by regional wind and hail exposure.
The seller has provided three years of audited financial statements and a draft purchase and sale agreement.

cases.question: What capital expenditures are projected for the next five years?

passages.text: Broker opinion of value places the asset between $38 million and $42 million based on a 6.25% cap rate.
The property condition report projects capital expenditures of $1.8 million over the next five years, primarily HVAC replacement in years two and three and parking lot resurfacing in year four.
Average in-place rents are 8% below market according to the appraisal's comparable lease analysis.

cases.question: Is there any pending litigation involving the property or seller?

passages.text: Real estate taxes were reassessed last year, resulting in a 12% increase in the annual tax liability.
The title commitment lists standard utility easements along the northern boundary of the parcel.
Seller disclosures indicate one pending litigation matter: a slip-and-fall claim filed in 2025, fully tendered to the property's general liability carrier with no expected uninsured exposure.
